subject: ROH calculation and visualisation using gl.plot.snp.density()

messages.author: e128ae1057d75fd3
messages.subject: ROH calculation and visualisation using gl.plot.snp.density()
parts:
Hi dartR team,

Usually I calculate Runs of Homozygosity (ROH) using PLINK. Is it possible to produce ROH data for selected individuals or specific populations (for example, to compare regions with highly homozygosity and/or highly heterozygosity between two populations or more) and visualize them using gl.plot.snp.density with ability to setting the window size?

I’ve attached example figure from the article https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-23222-9/figures/1.

Best regards,
Rizki
